title: The Robot and the Pilot

pages.text: A robot named Robo lived in a little cabin near the airplane runway.
pages.scene: A friendly robot standing outside a small cabin near an airport runway.

pages.text: Robo had always wanted to be a pilot and fly an airplane someday.
pages.scene: The robot gazing at airplanes taking off, dreaming expression on its face.

pages.text: One sunny day, a paper airplane landed right outside the cabin door.
pages.scene: A paper airplane floating down and landing near the robot's cabin door.

pages.text: Robo picked up the paper and read the simple message written on it.
pages.scene: The robot holding the paper airplane, reading the note carefully.

pages.text: The note said a tiger pilot needed a robot helper at the airport.
pages.scene: Close-up of the note with a drawing of a tiger pilot.

pages.text: Robo felt a tingle of excitement and hurried to the airport right away.
pages.scene: The robot running excitedly toward the airport terminal building.

pages.text: At the middle of the runway stood a purple airplane with sparkles.
pages.scene: A vibrant purple airplane covered in sparkles sitting on the runway.

pages.text: A tiger in a uniform stood beside the airplane with a gentle smile.
pages.scene: A tiger wearing a pilot uniform, smiling warmly at the approaching robot.

pages.text: The tiger pilot said that flying was simple if you stayed focused.
pages.scene: The tiger gesturing while explaining, robot listening attentively.

pages.text: Before the flight, they checked the airplane from nose to tail together.
pages.scene: Robot and tiger inspecting the airplane, checking various parts.

pages.text: They made sure even the little handle on the door was working well.
pages.scene: Close-up of hands checking the door handle mechanism.

pages.text: After the check, they climbed into the cockpit of the purple airplane.
pages.scene: Robot and tiger climbing into the airplane cockpit, excited expressions.

pages.text: The tiger showed Robo how to open the throttle and start the motor.
pages.scene: Inside the cockpit, tiger demonstrating the controls to the robot.

pages.text: The airplane began to rumble and shake as the engine came alive.
pages.scene: The airplane vibrating on the runway, propeller spinning fast.

pages.text: They raced down the runway and lifted up into the sunshine outside.
pages.scene: The airplane taking off into a bright blue sky with fluffy clouds.

pages.text: Robo looked outside and saw the whole city spread out far below them.
pages.scene: View from airplane window showing the city and landscape below.

pages.text: They flew over a purple castle and a lake that sparkled like a bottle.
pages.scene: Aerial view of a purple castle and a shimmering lake below.

pages.text: The tiger let Robo take the controls and steer the airplane in circles.
pages.scene: Robot at the controls, tiger watching proudly as they fly.

pages.text: Flying felt like a puzzle that Robo was finally able to solve.
pages.scene: The robot looking confident and happy while piloting the plane.

pages.text: After landing, the tiger gave Robo a little golden apple badge to keep.
pages.scene: The tiger pinning a golden apple-shaped badge on the robot.

pages.text: Robo knew that homework and practice would make future flights even better.
pages.scene: Robot studying a flight manual in its cabin, determined expression.

pages.text: From that birthday moment on, Robo the robot was also a real pilot.
pages.scene: Robot in pilot uniform standing proudly next to the purple airplane at sunset.

parent_tips.after_reading: Ask deeper questions: Why do you think Robo made that choice? How did the story change from beginning to end? What would you have done?
